title: OT-2 PCR Prep 1/2: Master Mix Assembly
author: Opentrons (verified)
materials: Master Mix Distribution and DNA Transfer](./pcr_prep_part_

steps.title: Configure OT‑2 deck and pipettes
steps.instruction: Place the optional tube rack(s) and a 12‑well reservoir on the deck, ensuring the master‑mix target is in well A1 and any reagent wells are in A2‑A12; load the specified single‑channel pipette on the right mount, the specified single‑channel pipette on the left mount, and load either filter tips or regular tips as indicated.

steps.title: Load master‑mix CSV file
steps.instruction: Provide the master‑mix .csv file (format described elsewhere) to the protocol so it can read reagent names, source locations, and volumes.

steps.title: Transfer reagent to reservoir A1
steps.instruction: Read the next line of the CSV, then use the designated pipette and tip type to aspirate the specified volume of that reagent from its source tube or reservoir well and dispense it into reservoir well A1 (the leftmost well).

steps.title: Repeat until CSV processed
steps.instruction: Continue reading each subsequent line of the CSV and performing the transfer step until all entries have been processed, resulting in the complete master mix in well A1.
